properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony's words, 2026-10-29: ""cues" as in "visual cues" came to mind as we discussed "recall". Visual cues are nonverbal signals, marks, or objects that engage the sensory system to direct attention, convey meaning, or help interpret spatial and environmental information. If reflow2 is a black box system and the AI agent is another black box system and we have an "interface" between them...I think one of the messages between the two that is related to recall is that something should offer "cues" to improve recall. Thinking this should be within the reflow2 black box of functions?"

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS, in pieces and under other names (accepted): a hint names its next call (req:a-hint-names-its-next-call); a discipline is delivered at the tool that triggers it (req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue); a lesson is served at the step it concerns (req:a-lesson-is-served-at-the-step-it-concerns); reads surface loop debt (req:read-surfaces-debt); the path that interrupts an agent is proven to (req:nudge-path-proven); the near-matches a write hands back; the Stop and SessionStart hooks the kit installs. None of them is named as one kind of message, so nobody can ask which cues exist, which are followed, or which are noise.

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) NAME IT IN THE INTERFACE: a cue is one declared kind of message reflow2 sends, with a few kinds (next call, lesson, related record, owed work, the person's lens), one consistent place in every reply, ranked and budgeted.
(b) ASSOCIATIVE CUES: reflow2 notices what the agent is touching (the node, the tool, the words) and offers what is linked to it: "a failed route, a rule, a lesson or a recent change sits on this". Recall triggered by context, the way a familiar place brings back a memory.
(c) CUES FROM THE AGENT'S SIDE: the harness hooks reflow2's kit installs (session start, before a tool, at stop) and the server's connect-time instructions. These reach an agent that has not called reflow2 at all.
(d) MEASURE EACH CUE: give every cue an id and count whether the agent acted on it; drop the cues that are never followed. It plugs straight into the recall measurement started today.
(e) CUES FOR THE PERSON: on flo2's pages, marks that draw the owner's eye (an unread lesson, an open question waiting on them, a stale number), the literal "visual" cue.

PUSHBACK:
- INSIDE THE BOX IS NOT ENOUGH. reflow2 can only answer when it is called; a cue can only ride a reply. The original failure, the person reminding the agent to use reflow2 at all, happens BEFORE any call, so no cue inside reflow2 can reach it. That moment needs (c): the cue reflow2 owns but places on the agent's side. The note at the top of every session here ("reflow2: this project has reflow2 installed. Orient first...") is exactly such a cue.
- CUE FATIGUE. Every extra cue makes each one less likely to be read. Replies are already long (the person's description rides every reply; lessons are withheld to fit budgets), and reflow2 measured this before: a per-idea detector would have fired 115 times and been filtered within a week. A cue needs a budget and a ranking, and (d) to prune it.
- MOSTLY NAMING, NOT NEW FUNCTION. Much of (a) already exists in pieces; the gain is in naming, ranking and measuring them, not in adding more.
- FOR AN AGENT, "VISUAL" MEANS POSITION AND SHAPE. An agent's senses are text: what reads first, what is short, and a consistent mark (reflow2's descriptions already use ⭐ and 🛑 for this). Salience is position and brevity, not colour.

COST (a finding): (c) small, it extends hooks that exist; (d) small to moderate, on usage telemetry that exists; (a) moderate, a contract across the served tools, mostly consolidating; (e) moderate, flo2's pages; (b) largest: relevance ranking, and the noisiest if it is wrong.
properties.name: OPEN — should "cues" be one named kind of message on the interface between reflow2 and the agent, offered to improve recall, and does that belong inside reflow2's box, the agent's side, or both?
properties.rationale:
Anthony, following the recall requirement accepted the same day: if reflow2 and the agent are two black boxes with an interface between them, cues are one of the messages that cross it. Records the open part: naming cues as one kind of message, and which side owns them. Whether recall matters is already settled (req:an-agent-recalls-from-reflow2-what-it-needs-when-it-needs-it-and-the-recall-is-measured).
